grammar.label: non-defining relative clauses
grammar.meaning: extra information about something already identified

explanation.en: A non-defining clause adds extra information and takes commas. 'That' cannot be used, and the clause can be removed without changing who or what you mean.
explanation.uz: Qo'shimcha ma'lumot beruvchi ergash gap vergul bilan ajratiladi. 'that' ishlatilmaydi va bu gapni olib tashlash ma'noni buzmaydi.

grammar.positive_example: My brother, who lives in Almaty, is a nurse.
grammar.negative_example: My brother that lives in Almaty is a nurse, and I have only one brother.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbek tilida ergash gap otdan oldin keladi; vergulning ma'no farqi begona.

grammar.label: relative clauses with whose and when
grammar.meaning: possession and time inside a relative clause

explanation.en: 'Whose' replaces his/her/their inside the clause; 'when' introduces a time.
explanation.uz: 'whose' ergash gap ichida his/her/their o'rnini bosadi; 'when' vaqtni kiritadi.

grammar.positive_example: That is the woman whose car was stolen.
grammar.negative_example: That is the woman who her car was stolen.

story.title: The woman in the blue coat

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: Who was that, the person in the blue coat?

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: That is Dilnoza, who teaches at my school.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: The one whose son plays in Bobur's team?

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: That is her. She grew up in Andijan, where her family still lives.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: She has a very calm way with people.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: She has. She is the kind of person who never raises her voice.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: She studied in Moscow, which surprised me.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Because she never mentions it. Most people would.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: It is. Her reputation here comes only from her teaching.
